# Shelby Ceramic Coating

> Shelby Ceramic Coating provides mobile ceramic coating, car detailing, paint correction and cut and polish across Melbourne’s south-east. Savvy travels to customers’ homes or workplaces, after confirming the suburb and site setup.

## Business details

- Business name: Shelby Ceramic Coating
- Contact: Savvy
- Phone: 0490 699 614
- Website: https://www.shelbyceramiccoating.com.au/
- ABN: 29 650 058 996
- Service area: South-east Melbourne, Victoria
- Service model: Mobile. Shelby visits customers at home or work. Availability is confirmed for each address.
- Do not describe ceramic coating as scratch-proof, damage-proof or maintenance-free.
- Ceramic coating can add gloss and water repellency and can make routine washing easier. It does not prevent every scratch, stone chip or paint defect.
- Paint correction and cut and polish use machine polishing. The suitable scope depends on the vehicle’s paint and condition.
- Ceramic coating prices are starting prices. Vehicle size, paint condition and preparation affect the quote. Confirm current inclusions with Savvy.
- Do not infer a customer job’s suburb, vehicle service or result unless Shelby has confirmed those details.
